class.name: RosTfListener3D
class.brief_description: A spatial node that automatically updates its 3D transform from a ROS 2 TF2 frame.
class.description: [RosTfListener3D] is a helper node that simplifies the process of receiving coordinate transforms from ROS 2. As a descendant of [Node3D], it automatically queries the ROS 2 TF2 tree and updates its local transformation to match the spatial relationship between two specified frames. This node is ideal for aligning Godot objects (like cameras, robot models, or visual markers) with their real-world or simulated counterparts in a ROS 2 system.

members.member: The coordinate frame in the ROS 2 TF2 tree that provides the starting point for the spatial transformation.

The coordinate frame in the ROS 2 TF2 tree that defines the destination of the spatial transformation. The node's [member Node3D.transform] will be updated to match the pose of the [member target_frame] relative to the [member source_frame].
